pages.text: $(bold)Ender Power$() (built into void metal tools, $(bold)no levels$(), Iron's Spellbooks crossover)$(br2)The tool is imbued with $(bold)Teleport Lv3$() (irons_spellbooks:teleport) and $(bold)Arcane Shackle Lv3$() (irons_spellbooks:arcane_shackle).$(br2)Note: it only writes when the item has $(bold)no$() spell container yet, so it never overwrites your edits at the Arcane Anvil.$(br2)$(italic)The will of the Ender dimension is watching you...$()
